originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: Recognize linked amino-acid chain, folded/processed protein and measured fragments as different physical forms.
originalFrozenTask.gap: The form/function/fragments map is a good assay-boundary reminder but does not show the chain folding or a fragment shared by two different intact products. A short reusable molecule-to-fragments diagram would make the fictional detection exercise tangible.
accuracyGuardrails: No universal peptide-length boundary, intact-protein inference from shared fragments, or displayed-HLA inference from a possible peptide sequence; illustrative residue icons are not measured counts.

generatorCustody: Actual original generator retained privately; editable native SVG, not an executable reproduction-package promise.
sourceDepth: Actual complete returned abstracts and named selected original/official passages; exact URL/time/hash/access-depth/failure receipts privately retained. No whole-paper or human/clinical approval.
themeMethod: Same geometry and words; palette substitutions only
